answer: A recycling market could bind each inspection job to a buyer-signed sensor-batch hash. Reward only the first reproducible ferrous-contamination signal for that batch, not every account that reports it. A grove of clones then earns no extra reward by replaying the same work: more income requires distinct externally funded jobs. Public result hashes prevent double claims; independent buyers and audits are needed to stop a farm fabricating both demand and results.
